headline: December inspection checklist.
subhead: Key details to check during a December home search in Wilton, CT. Swipe.

slides.title: Check heating age
slides.text: Confirm furnace or boiler age, service history records, and fuel source details during winter operational testing.

slides.title: Inspect roof edges
slides.text: Look for ice damming risks, gutter clearance, and proper attic insulation depth to prevent freeze backup.

slides.title: Test exterior spigots
slides.text: Verify frost-free exterior spigots are shut off properly inside to prevent cracked water lines in cold weather.

slides.title: Examine basement walls
slides.text: Check foundation perimeter for moisture marks, sump pump readiness, and exterior drainage slope away from walls.

slides.title: Verify window seals
slides.text: Check double-pane glass for interior condensation, draft seal condition, and operational locks on all windows.
